Type vocabulary.question: Which notification type values should the enum ship for v1?
Type vocabulary.answer: D1 — All 7 spec types (COMMENT, REPLY, VOTE_MILESTONE, ANNOUNCEMENT, MODERATION, TIMELINE_REMINDER, SYSTEM). Phase 8 and the reminder beat reuse them with zero migrations; only 4 have v1 producers.

Type vocabulary.question: How should the type vocabulary be held on the model?
Type vocabulary.answer: D2 — Django TextChoices on the model per 07 §3.1 (choices + default=SYSTEM). Taxonomy is closed/system-owned; the settings-validator pattern (5.1 D1) is not applied here because types drive code dispatch.

Message & PII.question: Notification title/message content: stored snapshot or read-time composition?
Message & PII.answer: D3 — Snapshot at creation. The row is an immutable historical record per 07 §3.1/§4.1.1 templates; deleting the post later cannot rewrite what a user was told.

Message & PII.question: How does an ANONYMOUS actor appear in the stored message?
Message & PII.answer: D4 — Anonymity-safe label baked in at composition: service composes via AuthorPublicSerializer semantics ('A candidate' for ANONYMOUS, handle for DISPLAY_NAME). Stored text is already anonymity-safe; zero-PII is guaranteed once at creation, not re-derived per endpoint.

Read-state rules.question: How should is_read ↔ read_at consistency be enforced?
Read-state rules.answer: D5 — DB-level CheckConstraint (is_read=False OR read_at IS NOT NULL, named notification_read_state) plus a service-level mirror so violations surface as clean application errors, not IntegrityError.

Read-state rules.question: Should the unread-count seam ship in 6.1?
Read-state rules.answer: D6 — Ship an unread-count helper now (Notification.objects.unread_count_for(user) over the compound index). Dashboard keeps its 0 placeholder until 6.2 wires the call; contract is test-pinned in 6.1.
